architecture: Refinement of the existing roadtrip engine around one shared runtime execution layer rather than another UI hotfix. Discovery, regional fallback and accommodation now use the same concurrency/cache/progress primitives.

root_causes.cape_town_4_percent_hang: Selected-trip supply was serialized: it could wait up to 15 s for background discovery, then run as many as 16 Overpass batches sequentially with two sequential mirrors, then up to 20 Nominatim reverse lookups sequentially. The overlay stayed at 4% because none of those internal waits reported progress.
root_causes.missing_accommodation: Accommodation depended only on Overpass within limited radii. A provider miss or sparse OSM tourism tagging left a night empty even when a real accommodation could be found via a different OSM search path.
root_causes.blurry_images: The active progress assets are only about 8–15 KB each in the repository, while the existing photo hero assets are roughly 145–185 KB. The atlas-style frames were part of that low-resolution progress set.

engine_changes.runtime_engine: Added roadtrip-runtime-engine.js for bounded concurrency, first-success provider racing and TTL caching.
engine_changes.selected_trip_supply: Anchor discovery bypasses background locks, searches only relevant anchor batches, runs up to four batch workers concurrently, races both Overpass mirrors and reports live progress.
engine_changes.regional_fallback: Nominatim seeds run six at a time, cache results and report progress.
engine_changes.accommodation: Each overnight runs through 12/25/45 km Overpass search and then Nominatim fallback if needed, with explicit user-visible progress and no short outer watchdog.
engine_changes.images: Low-resolution progress/atlas image set removed from active rotation. Only existing higher-resolution scenic photo assets are used; each remains visible for 5 seconds.

without_quality_tradeoff: Concurrent independent geographic queries instead of serial queries
Race redundant provider mirrors instead of waiting for one to fail before trying the next
Cache identical region lookups for repeat plans/retries
Stop selected-trip region search as soon as the solver has enough real overnight supply
Keep weather/image enrichment off the critical path where it does not affect plan validity
